kinds.name: Let the agent pick
kinds.purpose: Say what you want to see and the agent chooses the diagram type.

kinds.name: System context
kinds.purpose: The system, its users and the external services around it.

kinds.name: Design patterns
kinds.purpose: The design patterns the code uses and where they sit.

kinds.name: Change impact
kinds.purpose: What the current change touches and what depends on it.

kinds.name: Feature plan
kinds.purpose: A described future feature as planned blocks beside the code it touches.

kinds.name: Sequence
kinds.purpose: Who calls whom, in order, for one flow.

kinds.name: Custom type
kinds.purpose: A diagram type of your own or a saved one.
